title: Psychologists Beg You To Understand Hedonic Adaptation
hook: This explains everything about your last bad week.
description:
Hedonic Adaptation — explained in 60 seconds.

Every upgrade becomes your boring baseline within weeks. Your brain resets happiness to neutral.

What actually happens in your brain: Evolution can't let you stay satisfied — satisfaction stops the striving that kept ancestors alive. You're built to adapt.

Try it today: Want more joy? Don't add. Pause and subtract familiarity: skip your favorite thing for 2 weeks.
